lead.en: Write Flexmi models in XML and YAML, resolve references by name, diagnose loading problems and inspect model diagrams.
lead.zh: 用 Flexmi 的 XML 和 YAML 写法编写模型，按名称解析引用，排查载入问题，并查看模型图。

prerequisites.en: Modules 1 and 2, or a basic grasp of Ecore classes, containment and references. No local installation is needed.
prerequisites.zh: 完成第 1、2 模块，或已了解 Ecore 的类、包含和引用。无需本地安装。

en: Create a nested Flexmi model from an Emfatic metamodel.
Write equivalent small models with the XML and Epsilon 2.8 YAML flavours.
Resolve references with fully qualified names and explain ambiguous short names.
Spot model-loading warnings and distinguish them from program output.
Use Playground diagrams and simple Emfatic annotations to inspect a model.
zh: 根据 Emfatic 元模型创建嵌套的 Flexmi 模型。
用 XML 和 Epsilon 2.8 的 YAML 写法编写等价的小模型。
用完全限定名解析引用，并解释简短名称为何可能含糊。
识别模型载入警告，并区分警告与程序输出。
使用 Playground 图示及简单的 Emfatic 标注查看模型。
